title: Final Answer Isothermal
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the speed of sound in an isothermal process, c = sqrt(RT/M).

title: Final Answer Adiabatic
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the speed of sound in an adiabatic process, c = sqrt(gamma RT/M).

title: Correct Use of t
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly identify and apply the value of t for both isothermal (t = 1) and adiabatic (t = gamma) processes.

title: Differential Equation Setup
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly derive the differential equation dp/p + t dV/V = 0 for the general process.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that the units are consistent throughout the derivation.

title: Common Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign mistakes in the derivation of dp/dV and its relation to dp/drho.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all necessary factors, such as M and R, are included in the final expressions.
